App::App - Constructor of the class that initializes the Zcash wallet client.
App::createNewWallet - Creates a new wallet at the provided directory path.
App::restoreWallet - Restores a wallet using a provided seed phrase and birthday.
App::getSeed - Retrieves the seed of the wallet.
App::getAddresses - Retrieves the addresses associated with the wallet.
App::getBalance - Retrieves the balance of the wallet.
App::sync - Initiates synchronization of the wallet.
App::listTransactions - Retrieves a list of all transactions in the wallet.
App::pendingTransactions - Retrieves a list of pending transactions.
App::receivedTransactions - Retrieves a list of received transactions.
App::sentTransactions - Retrieves a list of sent transactions.
App::sendTo - Sends a transaction to a specified address with an amount and memo.
App::createNewWalletUsingRandomSeed - Creates a new wallet using a randomly generated seed.
App::createNewWalletFromKeyStore - Creates a wallet using a seed from a keystore.
App::start - Starts the synchronization process of the wallet.
App::stop - Stops the synchronization process of the wallet.
App::isSynchronizing - Checks if the wallet is currently synchronizing.
App::loadKeyStoreFromFile - Loads a keystore from a file.
App::saveKeyStoreOnFile - Saves a keystore to a file.
App::readFromKeyStore - Reads a protected data entry from a keystore.
App::writeToKeyStore - Writes a protected data entry to a keystore.
App::isValid - Validates a seed phrase.
App::createMnemonicAsWords - Generates mnemonic words for a seed.
App::createMnemonicString - Generates mnemonic strings for a seed.
App::saveKey - saves the key on a secure store. It relies on #readFromKeyStore to store the key in a JavaKeyStore
App::getKey - get the key from a secure store. It relies on #writeToKeyStore to store the key in a JavaKeyStore
App::createMnemonicString - Generates mnemonic strings for a seed.
